optimizedDescription.value: Assess VCS, content, derivation, schema, and coverage freshness with monotonic latches, scoped evidence, and warn-not-block reads.

optimizedContext.value:
# Staleness Detection
## Rules
- `IndexOptions.vcsRef?: string` persists opaque `lastIndexedRef` only after successful index; omitted => `null`.
- VCS state: non-null stored/current refs unequal => stale; equal => fresh; stored null => unknown, never stale.
- Derivation fingerprint combines running `@specd/code-graph` version, canonical resolved-workspace hash, effective discovery config, and newline-normalized hashes of adapter-declared resolution manifests. Version/layout/discovery/manifest change => explicit mismatch even with fresh VCS. CRLF/LF alone cannot mismatch.
- Graph reads (`graph stats`, `graph search`, `graph impact`, `graph hotspots`) warn/surface stale or mismatch metadata but return current stored results. Never reinterpret mismatch as fresh or auto-reindex.
- `graph index` repairs fingerprint mismatch by visible full recreation/rebuild or fails clearly requiring force re-index.
- `GraphStatistics.lastIndexedRef: string | null`. Text stale warning: `⚠ Graph is stale (indexed at <7-char-ref>, current: <7-char-ref>)`; no line when ref null. Mismatch warning mentions code-graph version, workspace configuration, or resolution manifest. JSON/TOON: `stale`, `currentRef`, `fingerprintMismatch` as `boolean | null`.
- Central filesystem index lock under config directory (for example `.specd/config/graph/index.lock`) provides acquire/release/`assertGraphIndexUnlocked` to all provider clients.
- Keep `isGraphStale` and fingerprint primitives here; hosts use `GetGraphHealth` for VCS resolution plus health/fingerprint assembly (`graph stats`, `project status --graph`, SDK snapshots), never reimplement inline.
- Build effective `ProjectGraphConfig` by merging global/workspace `allowedPaths`, `excludePaths`, `respectGitignore` with runtime/CLI overrides. Without `specd.yaml`, synthesize fallback `SpecdConfig` mapping repository root to one `default` workspace.
- Canonical health separates VCS-ref, working-tree/content, derivation, backend schema/generation, and index-coverage freshness. Matching ref cannot prove content current when tracked/untracked files differ. Expose stable reasons for dirty, unknown, partial, excluded, unsupported, parse-failed, fingerprint-mismatched, schema-incompatible.
- Missing symbol is stale only when target content current and supported coverage complete; otherwise absence inconclusive.
- Installed `@specd/code-graph` version participates in project/workspace derivation fingerprints and must change for enriched reference-model release. Backend schema version remains separate from package derivation and `schema-std`.
- Persist `knownStaleSinceLastIndex` per workspace and aggregate. True aggregate latch returns immediately without scan. First proven stale workspace/global input atomically sets applicable workspace plus aggregate; only successful index clears. State `current | stale | unknown`; precedence `stale > unknown > current`. Read/stat/hash/repository/VCS failures => transient unknown, never latch, retry later.
- Batch `AssessIndexedResourceFreshness` evaluates exact files/documents/specs from indexed-input observations. Matching mtime+size avoids reads; changed stamps hash. Equal content refreshes observation; changed/missing content latches stale. Repository inputs use stable revision/fingerprint. Any stale input => stale; otherwise any unassessable => unknown.
- Exact-resource consumers may trust current targeted evidence despite unrelated global staleness. Corpus-wide absence/uniqueness/ranking/workspace fallback retain global stale/unknown because returned-resource validation cannot prove completeness.
- VCS workspaces sharing repository root share one diff evaluation but retain workspace latches. Scope identity uses sorted workspace names, never absolute paths. Normalized fingerprint sorts graph-visible `{ path, state, contentHash }`, distinguishing present/missing.
- Filter `VcsAdapter.modifiedFiles()` through indexing-equivalent effective `excludePaths`, `allowedPaths`, gitignore, defaults, and code/document/spec channels before stat/hash. Changes excluded from every channel, including either rename side, do not affect health; mixed diffs include visible paths only. Visibility-config changes invalidate derivation fingerprint.
- Non-VCS workspaces compare visible membership and observations, stopping at first proven mismatch. VCS workspaces with `respectGitignore: false` use hybrid VCS/filesystem assessment for ignored untracked graph inputs.
## Constraints
- VCS-agnostic through `VcsAdapter` from `@specd/core`; refs opaque.
- Detection never auto-refreshes/reindexes.
- Locking, fallback config, config merging, freshness calculations stay inside `@specd/code-graph`/`@specd/core`, not CLI helpers.
